Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
It’s prime time for a Livia Prima artist series! Credited with more than fifty Magic cards, Livia is responsible for some of the game’s most gorgeous pieces. Each card in her drop drips with vivid color, immaculate detail, and vignettes of greater stories told before. As if the art wasn’t flavorful enough on its own, Livia even teamed up her husband to write the flavor text! No deck or collection could be considered complete without this artist series—grab yours today!

Contents:
• 1x Foil Akroma, Angel of Wrath
• 1x Foil Mikaeus, the Unhallowed
• 1x Foil Glissa Sunseeker
• 1x Foil Olivia, Mobilized for War
